prompts.cold: Create a SQUARE FLAT MATERIAL SWATCH sheet for UV-preserving reskin of an EXISTING 3D haunted town gate. Use the supplied gate T70 concept as COLOR and material reference, but output ONLY four precisely equal quadrants, each a straight-on seamless-looking 2D texture, with ruler-straight center division. Do not show any architecture, structure, landscape, lighting fixture, text, UV atlas, or perspective. TOP LEFT: chipped charcoal basalt and mortar, richly layered distinct cold blue-gray, muted violet mineral streaks, pale chalk efflorescence, speckles of silver-blue lichen; intricate stone variation and clear visible cold hue. TOP RIGHT: old timber grain with gray-brown core and desaturated blue-teal weathering embedded in cracks, rusted fastener marks; still visibly wood, not painted solid cyan. BOTTOM LEFT: pitted dark iron and bronze straps with substantial but varied green-blue oxidation/verdigris and brown rust; still reads metal. BOTTOM RIGHT: dark slate shingles with subtly distinct midnight blue-gray, violet mineral dust and pale broken edges. Fine detail, layered material colors, coherent texture scale. Saturated enough to read blue/teal against neutral charcoal at game camera distance, but not fluorescent or monochrome. EXACTLY four equal quadrants, no borders/gutters/labels/shadows/vignette. No flags or banners.
